t: This is Mandela Way, a street in Southwark named after Nelson Mandela. Mandela was an anti-apartheid revolutionary who served as President of South Africa from 1994 to 1999. He was the country's first black head of state and the first elected in a fully representative democratic election. He led the African National Congress from 1991 to 1997. His government focused on dismantling the legacy of apartheid and fostering racial reconciliation. In South Africa he is held in deep respect and often called by his clan name, Madiba.
